title: Effect of nitriding treatment on microstructure, mechanical property and wear mechanisms of AlxCoCrFeNi high entropy alloy coatings prepared by cold spraying

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical and smooth surface, with some larger particles seen attaching to the surface of several small satellite balls
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: Vacuum atomization under high pressure nitrogen atmosphere

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: sequential polishing with 400, 800, 1200, 1500, 2000 mesh sandpaper (~10 mins each) and polishing cloth on a metallographic polishing machine. the samples were immersed in anhydrous alcohol and cleaned using an ultrasonic cleaning machine for 15 min to remove surface stains and floating dust.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: significant deformation of particles. uneven bonding interface, primarily mechanical bonding. uniform powder particle distribution, minimal diffusion, few and dispersed pores. predominantly consisting of the FCC phase

Experiments.Notes: Hardness for Al 0.4 at cross-section. Note: surface hardness reported: 284.4 HV 0.3

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: nitriding treatment was conducted in a mixture of 25 % N2 and 75 % H2 for 8 h, with the temperature set at 580°C, the pressure at 260 Pa, and the voltage was set to 570 V.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: significant deformation of particles, surface is uniformly covered with nitride particles. uneven bonding interface, primarily mechanical bonding. uniform powder particle distribution, minimal diffusion, few and dispersed pores. mainly FCC phase and some nitride phases (XN)

Experiments.Notes: Al 0.4 nitride. microhardness reported as surface hardness, cross-section not reported.

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical and smooth surface, with some larger particles seen attaching to the surface of several small satellite balls
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: Vacuum atomization under high pressure nitrogen atmosphere

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: nitriding treatment was conducted in a mixture of 25 % N2 and 75 % H2 for 8 h, with the temperature set at 580°C, the pressure at 260 Pa, and the voltage was set to 570 V.
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: sequential polishing with 400, 800, 1200, 1500, 2000 mesh sandpaper (~10 mins each) and polishing cloth on a metallographic polishing machine. the samples were immersed in anhydrous alcohol and cleaned using an ultrasonic cleaning machine for 15 min to remove surface stains and floating dust.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: significant deformation of particles, surface is uniformly covered with nitride particles at a significantly higher density than the Al0.4 nitride sample. uneven bonding interface, primarily mechanical bonding. uniform powder particle distribution, minimal diffusion, few and dispersed pores. reduced pores and improved microstructure compared to other samples. mainly FCC phase and some nitride phases (XN)

Experiments.Notes: Al 0.7 nitride. microhardness reported as surface hardness, cross-section not reported.
